<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to select fail open, fail closed or fail locked valve position</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Choosing the Fail Safe Position</text>

<text x="130.0" y="165.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FO, fail open</text>
<text x="130.0" y="188.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ATC, cooling water</text>
<line x1="400" y1="218" x2="400" y2="244" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="237" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<polygon points="400,244.0 530.0,292 400,340.0 270.0,292" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="287.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Full close on</text>

<line x1="530" y1="292" x2="568" y2="292" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="549" y="280" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="570" y="262" width="200" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="287.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FC, fail closed</text>
<text x="670.0" y="310.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ATO, fuel gas</text>
<line x1="400" y1="340" x2="400" y2="366" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="359" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<polygon points="400,366.0 530.0,414 400,462.0 270.0,414" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="409.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">SIS final</text>
<text x="400" y="430.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">element?</text>
<line x1="270" y1="414" x2="232" y2="414" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="251" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="20" y="384" width="210" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="125.0" y="409.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FL, fail locked</text>
<text x="125.0" y="432.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">lock up relay</text>
<line x1="530" y1="414" x2="568" y2="414" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="549" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="570" y="378" width="210" height="74" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="675.0" y="397.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FL not allowed</text>
<text x="675.0" y="420.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">define FO or FC</text>
<text x="675.0" y="443.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">per IEC 61511</text>
<rect x="40" y="490" width="720" height="80" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="522" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">The process hazard decides the position, not instrument convenience.</text>
<text x="400" y="550" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Record FO, FC or FL on the P&ID; changing it later needs a management of change.</text>
</svg>

<text x="40" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Steam heating lines</text>
